nodes.description: mapping(uint => Transaction) public transactions; stores multisig transaction structs (destination,value,data,executed)
mapping(uint => mapping(address => bool)) confirmations; owner confirmations per transaction id
mapping(address => bool) isOwner; owner whitelist used by access-control modifiers
address[] owners; list of wallet owners
uint required; number of confirmations required to execute a transaction
uint transactionCount; monotonically increasing transaction id counter
bool internal reEntered = false; declared reentrancy guard, never actually used
address[] pendingBetsQueue; FIFO of unresolved player bets in ZethrGame
uint queueHead; index of the oldest unresolved bet
uint queueTail; next free slot in the pending bets queue
mapping(address => BetBase) bets; latest bet of each player (tokenValue/blockNumber/tier)
mapping(address => uint) pendingBetsMapping; player address to queue position (0 = not queued)
ZethrBankrollControllerInterface controller; bankroll controller used for auth and payouts
bool paused; gates bet placement via isNotPaused modifier
uint resolverPercentage; share of house profit paid to the resolver (x/1e6)
string gameName; human readable name of the game
executeTransaction(uint): marks tx executed then performs destination.call.value(value)(data); state is not finalised before the external call and executed is reset on failure
confirmTransaction(uint): records owner confirmation and immediately calls executeTransaction
submitTransaction(address,uint,bytes): creates and auto-confirms a transaction
addTransaction(address,uint,bytes) internal: stores new Transaction and increments transactionCount
revokeConfirmation(uint): clears an owner confirmation for a non-executed transaction
isConfirmed(uint) constant: counts confirmations from owners array against required
addOwner(address) onlyWallet: adds an owner to isOwner and owners
removeOwner(address) onlyWallet: removes owner, shrinks owners array, may call changeRequirement
replaceOwner(address,address) onlyWallet: swaps owner entries in owners and isOwner
changeRequirement(uint) onlyWallet: updates required confirmations
ZethrDice.execute(address,uint,uint,bytes): validates and stores a bet, appends to queue and resolves any previous bet
finishBetFrom(address) internal: resolves a player bet, calls bankroll.gameTokenResolution before clearing queue bookkeeping
getRollOutput(uint,uint8,uint8,uint,address): computes win/loss using block-based randomness
getRollResults(uint,uint8,uint8,uint,address): thin wrapper around getRollOutput
calculateProfit(uint,uint): computes max payout using raw multiply/divide/sub arithmetic
getBet(address) internal: returns Bet storage pointer obtained via inline assembly aliasing of BetBase
resolveExpiredBets(uint): walks the queue, resolves expired bets, pays resolver via controller.gamePayoutResolver
finishBet(): resolves the caller's own bet via finishBetFrom(msg.sender)
isBetValid(uint,uint,bytes) view: validates bet size and roll bounds against getMaxProfit()
random(uint,uint,address,uint) internal view: maxRandom(...) % _upper
maxRandom(uint,address,uint) private view: keccak256(blockhash(_blockn), entropy, index) randomness source
ownerPauseGame() ownerOnly: sets paused = true
ownerResumeGame() ownerOnly: sets paused = false
ownerSetResolverPercentage(uint) ownerOnly: writes resolverPercentage after bound check
ownerSetControllerAddress(address) ownerOnly: replaces controller
ownerSetGameName(string) ownerOnly: writes gameName
getMaxProfit() view: external call into ZethrTokenBankrollInterface(msg.sender)
msg.sender: caller address used for owner checks, bet ownership, resolver payout and bankroll auth
block.timestamp / block-level value (block.number, blockhash) used as randomness entropy and expiry reference
destination.call.value(value)(data) in executeTransaction: arbitrary external call with value and data
inline assembly block in getBet that re-points an uninitialised storage pointer (betBase_slot) to alias BetBase as Bet
bankroll.gameTokenResolution(...) external call executed before pendingBetsQueue/pendingBetsMapping bookkeeping is cleared
controller.gamePayoutResolver(msg.sender, tokensEarned) external payout call inside resolveExpiredBets
((_initBet * (100 - (_roll-1))) / (_roll-1) + _initBet) * houseEdge / houseEdgeDivisor - _initBet: raw unchecked arithmetic
int sum = - finishBetFrom(...): signed negation of a value that can equal the most negative int
ZethrTokenBankrollInterface(msg.sender).getMaxProfit(address(this)) external view call to an arbitrary caller-controlled address
transactionId parameter of confirmTransaction
transactionId parameter of isConfirmed
_player parameter of ZethrDice.execute (bet owner)
_playerAddress parameter of finishBetFrom
_numToResolve parameter of resolveExpiredBets
_controllerAddress parameter of ownerSetControllerAddress / constructor
bytes _data parameter of ZethrDice.execute (rolls and rollUnder packed)
_tier parameter of ZethrDice.execute
_blockNumber parameter of getRollOutput
_rollUnder parameter of getRollOutput
tokensEarned accumulator in resolveExpiredBets
head cursor over the pending bets queue in resolveExpiredBets
index of the player in pendingBetsQueue inside finishBetFrom
owner parameter of addOwner
destination parameter of addTransaction
value parameter of addTransaction
bytes data parameter of addTransaction

normalization_plan.reason: transactionId is a parameter of confirmTransaction and has no independent lifecycle; fold it into the confirmTransaction node
transactionId is a parameter of isConfirmed used only for mapping lookups; fold it into isConfirmed
_player is the bet owner parameter of ZethrDice.execute and is fully consumed inside it
_playerAddress is the parameter of finishBetFrom and only addresses the bets/queue mappings
_numToResolve only bounds the loop inside resolveExpiredBets
_controllerAddress is the parameter that assigns the controller state variable in ownerSetControllerAddress
bytes _data of execute is decoded into rolls/rollUnder inside the same function
_tier of execute is stored into the bet struct and validated by the betIsValid modifier
_blockNumber of getRollOutput is used only as randomness input and expiry reference
_rollUnder of getRollOutput is used only for the win/loss comparison in the roll loop
local tokensEarned exists only to accumulate the resolver payout inside resolveExpiredBets
local head is the queue cursor of resolveExpiredBets
local index is derived from pendingBetsMapping inside finishBetFrom to clear the queue slot
owner parameter of addOwner is written straight into isOwner and owners
destination parameter of addTransaction is stored into the Transaction struct
value parameter of addTransaction is stored into the Transaction struct and later forwarded by the external call
bytes data parameter of addTransaction is stored and later executed by destination.call.value(value)(data)
